lifeTallyCheck.note: LifeTally counts the states at ticks from+1..until, DayShape those at from..until-1: DayShape less its first tick plus the end state should equal LifeTally

windowCheck.note: FreeWindow (both age bands) against OutdoorCompany and DayShape, each by its own definition

tripShape.readOnly: reads the world only; no write, no random draw; the runner checks the saved state is byte-identical around a sample every 120 ticks, and the end hash is compared with the day probe run on the same save

definitions.walk: a maximal run of consecutive start-of-tick samples for one person with timeCategory travel and the same activity identity (id + kind + targetId); see the header of scripts/observers/trip_shape.ts

outcomes.arrived_did_job: the same activity reached its work phase and work was seen, or it ended in success, or it ended with progress or cycle above zero
outcomes.arrived_no_job: reached the end of its path (the sim's arrival test) or the work phase, and ended with no work seen and no progress or cycle
outcomes.switched_mid_walk: ended before arrival with the sim's outcome interrupted (not 'died'); the sim's detail is kept
outcomes.gave_up_before_arrival: ended before arrival with the sim's outcome failed or partial
outcomes.ended_other: the person died, or the activity reported success before arrival, or it left with no end record
outcomes.continued_same_activity: the same activity walked again after a pause (blocked, held for a conversation, or its kind or target was rewritten)
outcomes.censored: still walking, or paused and unresolved, at the end of the run

definitions.measuredWalks: closed walks that were not under way at the first sample and are not censored: distributions and outcome shares use these
definitions.movement: tiles moved = count of changes of floor(x), floor(y) between consecutive samples across the walk including the step after its last tick (a tile boundary crossed counts one, so a straight diagonal walk scores up to 1.41 times its length); walkedDistance = the sum of the straight steps between those samples, which is the true path length, so walkedDistanceOverStraightLine is the cleaner detour figure
definitions.ageStage: under_12 is ageYears < 12 at the first walking tick (AGE_CHILD); simStage is the sim's four stages

speed.note: realised movement per walking tick over all walks (left-censored and censored walks included, so it matches the tick totals); modifiers in the source are cited in sourceFacts

shareOfPlannedStraightLineCoveredBeforeT.note: covered = 1 - (straight distance from where they were to the stand spot) / (straight distance from the start to the stand spot), clipped to 0..1; walks with a planned distance of 0 are left out

endReasons.note: the sim's own record of how an activity ended (outcome | detail, digits shown as #), for walks that did not do the job

arrivalGeometry.note: the sim's arrival is the path being used up, which puts the walker exactly on the stand spot (pathfinding.ts, activities.ts stepTravel); a conversation can begin before that when the person is close enough, and a person being chased moves the stand spot

load.note: Capacity is a WEIGHT limit, not a count of items (people.ts carryCap, constants.ts CARRY_CAP, WEIGHT). unitsMoved is the change in item count between the pack at the end of the walk and the pack when the activity ended (or when its next walk began); weightMoved weights each unit by constants.ts WEIGHT; loadFraction is weightMoved / capacity. Only walks counted arrived_did_job whose pack after the work is known are in the moved figures.

haulingKinds.notIncluded: cart_haul (the load rides in the cart, not the pack), give, return_tool, tree_work, operate and every other kind

repeatVisits.definition: a walk is a repeat when the same person, on the same calendar day (tick / 2400), already made an earlier walk of the same activity kind, from a different activity, to a target (the stand spot when the activity has no target) within 2 tiles; the gap runs from the last walking tick of the nearest earlier such walk to the start of the repeat. Walks of one activity (legs) are never repeats of each other. repeatWalks counts the later walk of each such pair; walksToAPlaceVisitedMoreThanOnceThatDay counts both walks of each pair.

activitySwitchesPerPersonPerWakingDay.definition: an activity identity change while awake: at a sample, the person's activity has an id that is neither the id they had at the previous sample nor the id of the activity they had on hold (a resume is not a change), and pose is not sleep. Counted by calendar day (tick / DAY).

homeDistance.definition: straight-line tiles from the walk's target (target position at the start of the walk; the end position when the activity has no target) to the centre of the household's home building

notMeasured.item: target tile for walks whose activity carries no target (targetId 0 and no targetType)
notMeasured.why: the sim holds only the stand spot for them; targetTile is null and the spot is recorded instead

notMeasured.item: home distance for people whose household has no home building
notMeasured.why: nothing to measure from; the fields are null

notMeasured.item: pack after the work for walks that reached work while the activity was still running at the end of the run
notMeasured.why: the activity had not ended, so there is no end of the non-travel phase to read; load figures leave them out
the load rides in the cart, which is not the pack, so pack capacity does not describe it

notMeasured.item: why a switch happened beyond the sim's own detail string
notMeasured.why: the string (for example something better came up, switched to something else, danger nearby) is recorded; whether each is a change of mind is not decided here

notMeasured.item: the first step of an activity chosen and ended inside one step
notMeasured.why: never visible at a start-of-tick sample, so it has no walk

notMeasured.item: a person walking with the per-tick speed split into terrain, load and age
notMeasured.why: moveSpeed is not called (the observer calls nothing that could change state); the constants are cited in sourceFacts and the realised speed per walking tick is reported instead

notMeasured.item: walks already under way at the first sample
notMeasured.why: their start is before the run; kept in the tick totals, left out of distributions and outcome shares (flag leftCensored)

notMeasured.item: work done by a multi-walk activity attributed to one walk
notMeasured.why: when an activity walks more than once, end-of-activity facts (progress, cycle, pack after) belong to the activity; the pack after is given to the last walk that reached work

sourceFacts.note: Each fact is a line (or a few) read from the source file in this worktree when the report was made: file, 1-based line, text. liveValue is the exported constant itself where there is one. "found: false" means the line was not found by that anchor.

facts.topic: every activity gets a unique id when it is built
an activity is in the travel phase or the work phase
timeCategory calls a non-blocked activity in the travel phase 'travel' (the test TimeBudget and this observer share)
a blocked activity is 'waiting', so a pause on a.blocked ends a walk
a socialize activity is rewritten into converse on the same id (identity must include kind)
an exchange_journey activity is rewritten into socialize with a new target on the same id
a person spoken to has the activity put on hold (p.suspended); work reverts to travel with the path cleared
suspending a work-phase activity sets it back to the travel phase
a held activity is picked up again on the same object (same id)
the sim's arrival test: the path is used up
the last waypoint of a path is the exact stand spot, so arriving means standing on a.spotX, a.spotY
a step that reaches a waypoint puts the walker exactly on it
on arrival the work phase begins in the same step, and work runs the same tick

facts.topic: beginWork sets the phase to 'work' before the handler's begin runs
a handler's begin that returns a string ends the activity 'failed' with that reason, with progress still 0
an activity past its expiry ends 'failed' (or 'partial' with cycles done) with 'took too long'
a walk the sim cannot continue ends 'failed' with the blocked reason
a handler may make a walk wait (a.blocked set, no movement)
the single place an activity ends; the hook is called with outcome and detail
the hook is observation only, never saved

hungryTime.method: Person-ticks of living people who are awake (pose !== 'sleep', LifeTally's test) with hunger < 62. Category is timeCategory (time_budget.ts). packFood: foodUnits(p.inv) > 0 (economy.ts foodUnits: the test optEat applies from rules 45, options_survival.ts). homeStoreFood: the household's homeId building's store, foodUnits(store.items) > 0 ('empty' when it holds none; 'no_home' when the household has no home building). Hunger bands 0-19, 20-39, 40-61. Distance: the person's (x, y) to the centre of the home building (x + w/2, y + h/2), in tiles, floored: 0-8, 9-20, over20 (21 or more); 'no_home' when there is none. A person indoors counts at the position the sim holds for them.

meals.method: A meal starts on the first sampled tick on which a person's activity is (1) kind 'eat' (a meal from the pack, source own_pack) or kind 'eat_store' (a meal at a store: source home_store when the target building is the household's homeId, other_building_store for any other building, 'other' for a pile or a store that is gone), in the work phase (phase 'work': an eat_store is not counted while it is still walking to the store; hunger then is the hunger on arrival, and hungerAtDecision is the hunger the first time the activity was seen, which is the tick after it was chosen), or (2) kind attend_meal or host_meal with data.eating set (source 'other', detail shared_meal). Each activity id is counted once. Hungry wait: ticks from the sampled tick at which hunger last went from >= 62 to < 62 to the meal start (0 when hunger is 62 or more at the start); a person first seen already below 62 has a censored wait, counted from the first sample and listed separately. Under 12: ageYears < AGE_CHILD (12). Quartiles by linear interpolation between order statistics.

biteAudit.method: Every tick in which a person's lastAteTick moved (set by every takeNutrition caller in the sim: act_resource.ts eat tick and gather-on-the-spot, meals.ts shared meal, hand_feeding.ts). Channel is the activity the person had at the previous sample. Bites outside the counted meals show what the meal list does not cover.

foodWhereItIs.method: At tick % DAY === 0 (dayFraction 0.30, 07:12; in arm C the dawn top-up at tick % DAY === 2280 has already happened). Units are counted with the lab's food kinds (LAB_FOOD_ITEMS = scripts/lab/lab.ts FOOD_ITEMS, lab.ts:186: no function; outcomeOf sums b.store.items over that constant); rendered_fat, which economy.ts foodUnits counts and the lab does not, is reported apart as renderedFatUnits. packs: living persons' inv. homeStores: building stores where isHomeType(b.type). otherBuildings: every other building's store, by building type. piles: pile.items. otherHeld: carcass remains in piles, batch inputs held by workplaces (b.ops.job.held), site.delivered, cart loads, tables of meals not done or cancelled: the containers economy.ts totalItems adds up. heldTotal is the sum of those. standing (wild source stock and farm plot grain stock) is food that is not held and is outside heldTotal. A head is a living person.
